# Three.js

The self-hosted ES module and core build are pinned to Three.js 0.186.1 (MIT).
These are jsDelivr's minified copies of the official npm builds, saved with
their original import-compatible filenames. The upstream MIT license is included.

Only the homepage's optional hero-depth enhancement loads these modules.
There is no third-party CDN request during normal portfolio browsing.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz
